cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing; a contemporary private overnight ferry cabin with a round window — she sits back after reaching for a folded blank timetable; a starship data archive — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; a hangar maintenance bay — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a walled garden with a lotus pond — standing; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a quiet modern seaside guesthouse bedroom with pale blue walls — she laughs softly at the distant cry of a gull while sitting up from a deep cushioned window seat; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — lying on her front; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a sunlit white marble temple — standing; a shopping mall atrium with a fountain and glass railings — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a retro American diner — carries a camera by its grip at her side
